stories_kpis.description: Americas Materials Solutions a vu son CA bondir de 21% au T1 2026 et son EBITDA ajuste de 75%, porte par des volumes de granulats en hausse de 14% et de ciment de 10%.

CRH a annonce l'acquisition d'Axius Water (0,7 Md$) pour renforcer sa position de leader des solutions d'infrastructure de l'eau aux Etats-Unis, dans une serie de neuf acquisitions pour 0,9 Md$ au T1 2026.
CRH a signe 1,9 Md$ de cessions strategiques sur trois activites non coeur (accessoires de construction, jardin, MoistureShield), reallouant le capital vers des plateformes a forte croissance.
International Solutions a vu son EBITDA ajuste progresser de 32% au T1 2026 grace aux efficacites operationnelles et a l'optimisation du portefeuille, malgre des volumes affectes par la meteo.
CRH a ete integre a l'indice S&P 500 en 2025, signe de reconnaissance de son echelle et de son leadership de marche, avec une performance record (resultat net exercice 2025 +8%, EBITDA ajuste +11%).

risks.title: Dépendance économique
risks.score_rationale: La société dépend fortement des cycles économiques et des conditions météorologiques, ce qui peut impacter ses résultats financiers. Cela est mentionné dans l'Item 1A, qui souligne l'importance de la demande sous-jacente dans les marchés de construction. Citation: "Where economically feasible, Net Debt* is maintained in the same relative ratio as capital employed". Position: bas Item 1A.

risks.title: Concurrence

Citation: "Commodity Products and Substitution CRH manufactures and supplies a large number of commodity products into". Position: milieu Item 1A.

company_description: CRH plc, together with its subsidiaries, provides building materials solutions in Ireland, the United States, the United Kingdom, rest of Europe, and internationally. It operates through three segments: Americas Materials Solutions, Americas Building Solutions, and International Solutions. The company offers building materials for the construction and maintenance of public infrastructure, and commercial and residential buildings, as well as construction and renovation of transportation infrastructure, critical utility networks, commercial and residential buildings, and outdoor living spaces; paving and construction services; and produces and sells aggregates, cementitious materials, ready mixed concrete and mortars, and asphalt. It also manufactures, supplies, and delivers building products for the built environment in communities in North America; and provides building and infrastructure solutions for complex critical utility infrastructure, such as water, energy, transportation, and telecommunications projects, and outdoor living solutions for private and public spaces.
